evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `claim_run_dir` creates the record base and a new run directory under it, then returns without syncing the base directory. Syncing the receipt and run directory does not persist the new run-directory entry in the base, and creating a new base also requires syncing its parent. A crash after admission can therefore lose the run directory and its recorded prior SHA/trigger state. The fix is a routine crash-consistency repair: fsync the base after `mkdir`, fsync the base's parent when the base was newly created, and refuse admission if either sync fails.
